mapper.select: select sm.perms from sys_menu sm inner join sys_role_menu srm on sm.id = srm.menu_id where srm.role_id = #{roleId} and sm.perms is not null

select distinct m.id, m.parent_id, m.name, m.redirect, m.component, m.icon, m.sort, m.title, m.target, m.active_menu, m.type, m.path, m.link_url, m.hidden, m.fullscreen, m.affix, m.keep_alive, m.badge, m.badge_type, m.perms, m.status, m.remark from sys_menu m inner join sys_role_menu rm on m.id = rm.menu_id where rm.role_id in
#{roleId}
